description: A scene manager for K-ARP: it stores whole K-ARP setups in sixteen slots and recalls them, either on a click or one after another as the chord sequence comes round

params.text: Chooses between storing scenes and playing them; in the storing position the module never recalls a scene by itself, leaving K-ARP free to be edited and heard
In the playing position, chooses whether the next stored scene is taken automatically at the end of each pass through the chord sequence, or only when you click a slot

outputs.text: A 5ms pulse at 10V at the end of each pass through K-ARP's chord sequence, sent before the scene changes or repeats

notes: this module goes immediately to the right of K-ARP and does nothing anywhere else: it reads the module on its left and ignores anything that is not K-ARP.
the sixteen scene slots are drawings rather than knobs, so clicking one opens no help.
while storing, a click arms a slot and a second click on it writes the current K-ARP setup there.
while storing, a long press of three quarters of a second arms a filled slot for deletion, and a second click on it confirms.
a click anywhere else on the panel cancels a slot that has been armed for writing or deletion.
the AUTO and MANUAL switch is held at MANUAL while the module is storing, and is put back to AUTO the moment it returns to playing, so a MANUAL choice does not survive a trip through STORE.
slots fill in order and cannot be skipped: a slot can be written only if every slot before it is already filled, and deleting one shifts the slots after it down to close the gap.
while storing, Ctrl-click a filled slot to load it into K-ARP without arming anything, which is how a stored scene is brought back for editing.
arming a slot to write or delete is refused while K-ARP is running; stop K-ARP first. Editing and listening are what the storing position is for while it runs.
menu: Loop AUTO — sets whether the automatic playing returns to the first scene after the last one or stays on the last
EOC on RUN/RST — adds a pulse at the EOC output when K-ARP goes from stopped to running, so a sequencer downstream can be started in step
Clear all scenes — empties all sixteen slots
